# Upgrade acceptance fixtures

Small generated documents, with no user data. DOCX/PPTX/XLSX are the existing Office probe fixtures (Office Word/PPT/Excel test). BIFF8 XLS was generated using xlwt 1.3.0 with a single sheet, A1=XLS_ACCEPT_017 and A2=42. xlwt is only a fixture-generation tool, not a product/runtime dependency. CSV/TSV are generated by the probe.

The isolated probe intercepts the public llm/stream event using a deterministic fixture; it verifies that the native loop receives project and library context without a paid model call. It does not evaluate model reasoning quality.
